must_follow_rules: Inspect before modifying; create a backup before editing any workbook.
Do not treat blanks as zero, formatting as value, filters as full data, or hidden sheets as irrelevant.
Do not invent company-specific formulas, thresholds, mappings, API schemas, or accounting policy.
Prefer Excel-native methods for transparent low-complexity work; use Python-in-Excel only when it adds clear value and current availability/privacy are verified.
Do not use Python-in-Excel for credentialed API calls, unattended scheduled jobs, or backend production workflows.

top_reusable_risks.risk: Blank values are not the same as zero values
top_reusable_risks.rule: Check whether blanks mean unknown, not applicable, not yet entered, or a valid zero before aggregation.
inspect: inspect formulas that coerce blanks to zero
document the organization rule for missing values

top_reusable_risks.risk: Percent convention ambiguity
top_reusable_risks.rule: Validate whether percent fields are decimals, whole percents, or text with % symbols before formulas or uploads.
inspect: check number formats against raw values
require a documented convention for every percent field

top_reusable_risks.risk: Hidden sheet dependency
top_reusable_risks.rule: Unhide or inspect hidden/very hidden sheets before changing formulas, deleting sheets, or trusting workbook outputs.
inspect: map formulas that reference hidden sheets

top_reusable_risks.risk: Formula drift across repeated rows or periods
top_reusable_risks.rule: Compare formulas by R1C1 pattern across expected formula bands and period columns.
inspect: highlight manual constants in formula zones

top_reusable_risks.risk: Stale PivotTable cache
top_reusable_risks.rule: Verify source range/table and refresh state before relying on pivot output.
inspect: check source range or table name
compare pivot totals to source totals

top_reusable_risks.risk: Merged cells in import ranges
top_reusable_risks.rule: Remove or isolate merged cells from machine-readable source and upload ranges.
inspect: scan import rectangles for merged cells
convert report layouts into normalized tables
keep merged cells only in presentation zones

top_reusable_risks.risk: External links may be stale, broken, or unauthorized
top_reusable_risks.rule: Inventory external links and confirm each expected source before refresh or distribution.
inspect: replace ad hoc links with controlled imports when needed

top_reusable_risks.risk: Manual overrides can hide broken formulas or policy exceptions
top_reusable_risks.rule: Separate manual input zones from formulas and require override documentation.
inspect: scan formulas vs constants in protected zones

top_reusable_risks.risk: Date serial and text-date ambiguity
top_reusable_risks.rule: Parse and validate dates before grouping, week-ending checks, or uploads.
inspect: check data type and display format

top_reusable_risks.risk: Currency format is not numeric value
top_reusable_risks.rule: Confirm currency fields are numeric and formats are presentation-only.
inspect: strip text currency only in clean layer
compare totals before and after coercion

top_reusable_risks.risk: Chart built from unvalidated data
top_reusable_risks.rule: Validate source range, grain, missing values, axis scales, and filters before publishing charts.

top_reusable_risks.risk: Broken or ambiguous named ranges
top_reusable_risks.rule: Resolve and document names used by formulas, charts, pivots, and upload templates.
inspect: flag names referring to errors or deleted sheets

top_reusable_risks.risk: Filtered rows can conceal data in review
top_reusable_risks.rule: Record active filters and compare visible-only and full-range totals when reviewing outputs.
inspect: clear or document filters before signoff

top_reusable_risks.risk: Duplicate keys in supposed unique grain
top_reusable_risks.rule: Validate uniqueness at the intended grain before lookup, merge, pivot, or upload.
inspect: identify exact duplicate rows separately from duplicate business keys

top_reusable_risks.risk: Missing or stale refresh timestamp
top_reusable_risks.rule: Require a refresh log with source, timestamp, operator, and row counts for repeatable reports.
inspect: compare expected period to extract period
block upload when timestamp is stale

top_reusable_risks.risk: Python in Excel cloud execution boundary
top_reusable_risks.rule: Verify tenant/subscription/channel support and privacy requirements before using Python in Excel.
inspect: confirm workbook data may be processed in the supported cloud boundary
avoid relying on local files or local network access

top_reusable_risks.risk: Python package availability is curated
top_reusable_risks.rule: Check whether required libraries are available; use external Python when a custom package or system dependency is required.
inspect: replace unavailable libraries with supported ones

top_reusable_risks.risk: Python in Excel privacy and network boundary
top_reusable_risks.rule: Do not place secrets, API tokens, or network-dependent workflows in Python-in-Excel cells.
inspect: route credentialed workflows to approved external systems

top_reusable_risks.risk: Python in Excel performance and compute limits
top_reusable_risks.rule: Profile row counts and calculation dependencies before embedding Python in active workbooks.
inspect: prefer Power Query/external Python for large scheduled transforms

top_reusable_risks.risk: Python in Excel is not a production scheduler
top_reusable_risks.rule: Use external Python, BI platform refresh, or approved orchestration for unattended production work.

top_reusable_risks.risk: xl() reference shape mismatch
top_reusable_risks.rule: Check the returned object shape before cleaning, merging, or plotting.
inspect: use explicit table references when possible

top_reusable_risks.risk: Python output spill or object/value mismatch
top_reusable_risks.rule: Choose Python object vs Excel value deliberately and reserve spill ranges.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Required sheet missing.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: List sheets and compare to contract before editing.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Required table missing or empty.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Required column absent or duplicated.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Unparsed required date value exists.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Any required row outside expected week-ending date.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Read control period and compare every row.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Mixed convention detected in same field.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Do not calculate with percent fields until convention is documented.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Required amount has nonnumeric text.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Test numeric coercion and preserve raw extract.

critical_gates_digest.gate: No formula errors in output range
critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Any blocking error in required output range.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Scan outputs after refresh/recalc and before saving final.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Hidden sheet created/deleted/changed in protected workbook.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Inventory hidden sheets before/after modifications.

critical_gates_digest.gate: No merged cells in import range

critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Scan import rectangles for merged cells before table conversion.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Duplicate required unique key exists.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Validate grain before pivot, merge, or upload.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Blank required key exists.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Reject blanks before formulas/joins.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Missing timestamp or older than configured maximum.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Require source/time/row count in refresh log.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Pivot totals do not equal source totals after refresh.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Inspect pivot source and refresh before trusting output.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Name points to #REF! or missing sheet.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Resolve every contract name before modifying workbook.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Unknown external link exists in final workbook.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Inventory links and confirm each is expected.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Constant found where formula required and no override log.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Detect constants in formula zones and cross-check audit trail.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Spill blocked in output zone.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Reserve ranges and test return shape.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: PY cell affects output and lacks review note.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: List PY cells before final save.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Unexplained row count change between stages.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Capture row counts for every transformation step.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Missing/extra required field or invalid type.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Validate schema before creating upload file.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Required control field blank.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Read control sheet before analysis.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Chart source cannot be traced or fails source gate.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Trace every chart before publishing.

critical_gates_digest.blocking_condition: Formula in protected zone changed without approval.
critical_gates_digest.agent_check: Compare against template before delivery.

architecture_digest.pattern: Raw data / clean data / analysis / output separation

architecture_digest.when: Workbook distributes human-readable summary or upload preview.
agent_rules: edit source/analysis layers, not output numbers

architecture_digest.when: Templates used by nontechnical users or repeated periods.
agent_rules: backup before unprotecting
never replace formulas with constants without override record

architecture_digest.when: Users need to enter assumptions, comments, or small adjustments.
agent_rules: do not create new ad hoc input cells
do not enter values in formula zone

architecture_digest.when: Workbook has many formulas, uploads, or reviewer handoff.
agent_rules: run after refresh and before final save
do not hide failing gates

architecture_digest.when: Any workbook pulling system exports, Power Query, pivots, or external links.
agent_rules: do not publish without refresh log

architecture_digest.when: Templates, uploads, and multi-user workbooks with non-obvious fields.

architecture_digest.when: Scorecards, executive dashboards, or KPI reports.
agent_rules: do not change formula text without metric definition update
do not infer thresholds
do not overload with raw tables

architecture_digest.when: Workbook prepares records for API/file upload.
agent_rules: do not upload from raw or report sheets
do not include secrets or tokens

architecture_digest.when: Workbooks with manual overrides, financial outputs, or multi-user review.

architecture_digest.when: Repeated templates, dashboards, or workbook repairs.
agent_rules: create backup before structural edits

current_verification_active_digest.why: Python-in-Excel access depends on Microsoft 365 plan, platform, update channel, and rollout state.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Confirm user tenant/subscription, platform, update channel, and whether PY formulas can be authored/edited.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support documents plan/platform/channel-specific availability, including preview states for some subscriptions/platforms.

current_verification_active_digest.why: Workbook data processed by Python in Excel runs in Microsoft Cloud containers, which matters for privacy and governance.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Confirm organization allows the workbook data to be processed by Python in Excel cloud runtime.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support states Python code runs in secure Microsoft Cloud containers and does not persist data in Microsoft Cloud.

current_verification_active_digest.flag: Python in Excel network and local access
current_verification_active_digest.why: Python-in-Excel code should not be assumed to access local files, network resources, or user tokens.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Check for pandas.read_csv/read_excel, requests, API tokens, local paths, and network assumptions.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support states Python code lacks access to computer/devices/account/user token and common external data functions are not compatible.

current_verification_active_digest.flag: Power Query import boundary for Python in Excel
current_verification_active_digest.why: External data for Python-in-Excel workflows should be loaded through Power Query according to Microsoft docs.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Confirm Power Query connection, credentials, refresh behavior, and loaded table name.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support states Power Query is the way to import external data for use with Python in Excel.

current_verification_active_digest.why: Python-in-Excel package set is curated and may change; custom libraries may not be available.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Check current Microsoft/Anaconda package list and test imports in target workbook.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support says Python in Excel comes with a standard/core set of libraries provided by Anaconda.

current_verification_active_digest.why: Performance and calculation modes can depend on subscription/add-on/compute level.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Confirm standard vs premium compute, calculation mode support, and workbook performance in target tenant.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support documents Python in Excel add-on differences including compute and calculation mode support.

current_verification_active_digest.why: The Python Editor is not guaranteed across all plans/channels/platforms.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Confirm the target user can open the Python Editor or provide alternate review method.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support documents version/channel availability for Python in Excel Code Editor.

current_verification_active_digest.why: PY function syntax/return types determine whether output is Excel value or Python object.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Check return_type, spill behavior, and downstream formula compatibility.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support documents PY(python_code, return_type) with return_type 0 Excel value and 1 Python object.

current_verification_active_digest.why: Error causes and restrictions change; #BLOCKED! may indicate policy/availability, not formula logic.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Check current troubleshoot page when #PYTHON!, #BLOCKED!, or availability errors appear.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support provides current troubleshooting guidance for Python in Excel errors and subscription limitations.

current_verification_active_digest.why: Plot behavior and supported libraries depend on current Python-in-Excel environment.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Test Matplotlib/seaborn imports and plot display in target workbook.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support describes creating plots with libraries such as seaborn and Matplotlib in Python in Excel.

current_verification_active_digest.why: Copilot features and Python-backed analysis depend on licensing, platform, and rollout.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Confirm Copilot availability and generated-code review workflow in target tenant.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support says Copilot in Excel can use Python in Excel for advanced analysis and insights.

current_verification_active_digest.why: Dynamic array/text functions may not exist in older Excel versions used by recipients.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Check target Excel version before using VSTACK, TEXTSPLIT, FILTER, UNIQUE, etc.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Microsoft Support maintains function-specific pages for current Excel function availability and behavior.

current_verification_active_digest.why: The source books do not define company-specific formulas, thresholds, mappings, or posting rules.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Confirm metric definitions, account mappings, thresholds, sign conventions, and approval workflow with the business owner.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: No universal external source can replace organization policy; this is a required human verification flag.

current_verification_active_digest.why: API schemas and upload field requirements can change independently of the workbook.
current_verification_active_digest.check_now: Verify current schema, required fields, type rules, idempotency keys, and retry/error handling before staging/upload.
current_verification_active_digest.status_summary: Current API contract or system upload template is authoritative, not the source books or v1 package.
sources: current API documentation or system upload template

source_separation_rules.direct_book_claims: Use canonical records with source_traceability. Do not upgrade operational extensions into book claims.
source_separation_rules.operational_extensions: Allowed for workbook safety, AI-agent workflows, and business templates when derivation labels them clearly.
source_separation_rules.current_flags: Current Microsoft/product behavior and organization policy must be verified at use time.
source_separation_rules.business_placeholders: Restaurant365, SevenRooms, Uber Eats, marketing, accounting, and API examples use placeholder fields; exact schemas and formulas must come from the organization.
